description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'SearchWrapperTest' that tests the behavior of the 'SearchWrapper' class within the 'SuiteCRM' project. It includes tests for engine fetching, searching, and configuration retrieval related to the search subsystem in SuiteCRM.

classes.name: SearchWrapperTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing SearchWrapper functionalities including engine fetch, search operations, and configuration retrieval within the SuiteCRM project.

methods.name: testFetchEngine
methods.description: Tests fetching an existing search engine ('ElasticSearchEngine') via reflection.

methods.name: testFetchEngineNonExisting
methods.description: Tests that fetching a non-existing engine throws 'SearchEngineNotFoundException'.

methods.name: testFetchEngineCustom
methods.description: Tests fetching a custom engine ('MockSearch') from a specified directory.

methods.name: testFetchEngineCustomBad
methods.description: Tests that fetching a non-existing custom engine ('BadMockSearch') throws 'SearchEngineNotFoundException'.

methods.name: testGetEngines
methods.description: Verifies that 'getEngines' returns the expected list of available engine names.

methods.name: testSearchAndDisplayCustom
methods.description: Tests the 'searchAndDisplay' method using a custom engine ('MockSearch') and expects output to be '1'.

methods.name: testSearchAndDisplayBuiltIn
methods.description: Tests 'searchAndDisplay' with a built-in engine ('SearchEngineMock') by adding it dynamically.

methods.name: testFakeSearch
methods.description: Performs mock searches and verifies the returned hits ('bar' and 'barz').

methods.name: testSearchCustomEngine
methods.description: Uses a mocked SearchEngine object to test the search method invocation.

methods.name: testGetModules
methods.description: Checks that 'getModules' returns a non-empty array.

methods.name: testGetDefaultEngine
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of the default search engine from global config.

methods.name: testGetController
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of the search controller from global config.
